event: A splashing sound occurs, and its location needs to be determined relative to a hypothetical robot standing by the countertop drip coffee maker and facing the stainless steel double wall oven.

sounding_object.description: A small white ceramic bowl, round, approximately 4-5 inches (10-13 cm) in diameter. At the time of the sound, it contains pieces of fruit and some liquid (likely fruit juice or water), which splashes when the bowl is accidentally tipped over on the wooden dining table.

reference_object.description: A black electric drip coffee maker located on the kitchen counter. It appears to be made of plastic and metal, of a standard household size.

facing_object.description: A stainless steel double wall oven, built into the kitchen cabinetry on the far wall of the kitchen, to the right side.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the countertop drip coffee maker and facing the stainless steel double wall oven, when the splashing sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
